definitions: An online editor and live preview tool for Mermaid diagrams, which are text-based diagrams and flowcharts.
A web-based platform for creating and rendering Mermaid syntax into visual diagrams.
examples: I used Mermaid.live to quickly visualize the new system architecture.
Share your diagram by sending the Mermaid.live URL.
Mermaid.live supports various diagram types, including sequence diagrams and gantt charts.
